description: Implementation of the WindowManager class for HTTP/2 window size management, including functions for window updates, size limit changes, and data buffering.

classes.name: WindowManager
classes.description: Manages HTTP/2 flow control window size, buffering, and updates, with callback mechanisms for window updates.

methods.name: DefaultShouldWindowUpdateFn
methods.description: Determines whether a window update should be sent based on current limits and delta.

methods.name: WindowManager::OnWindowSizeLimitChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the window size limit.

methods.name: WindowManager::SetWindowSizeLimit
methods.description: Sets a new window size limit and potentially notifies the listener.

methods.name: WindowManager::MarkDataBuffered
methods.description: Marks data as buffered, updates window size, and may notify listener.

methods.name: WindowManager::MarkDataFlushed
methods.description: Marks data as flushed, updates buffer, and may notify listener.

methods.name: WindowManager::MaybeNotifyListener
methods.description: Checks if a window update should be sent and notifies the listener if needed.
